denied: Your role ({{role}}) cannot do this: it needs the permission “{{permission}}”. Ask an administrator of your Nodestro server.

readOnly.look: You are signed in as {{role}}: you can look at everything, but not change or run anything.
readOnly.run: You are signed in as {{role}}: you can look at everything and start runs, but not change anything.

user.title: Your account
user.members: Members and roles are managed by the server's operator with the nodestro-server command line (see the operator runbook).

server.title: Your organization's server
server.text: Nodestro runs on a server of your organization. Your data stays on that server and goes only to the AI providers your operator allows.

settings.serverDescription: Applies to your workspace {{tenant}} on this Nodestro server.
settings.serverData: Your data is stored on the Nodestro server of your organization. Backups and the installation are looked after by its operator.

run.toolProblemsText_one: {{count}} tool call did not succeed. Check whether the result relies on it:
run.toolProblemsText_other: {{count}} tool calls did not succeed. Check whether the result relies on them:

toolProblem.rejected: rejected by a person, so the tool did not run
toolProblem.expired: nobody decided in time, so the call counted as rejected
toolProblem.denied: not allowed by the approval rules

run.interrupted: Nodestro stopped while this run was running.
run.shutdown: Nodestro was stopped (for example the app was quit or the server restarted) while this run was running; it was not cancelled by anyone.
run.unfinished_one: The run ended while {{count}} step had not finished: {{steps}}. It never got a result.
run.unfinished_other: The run ended while {{count}} steps had not finished: {{steps}}. They never got a result.
run.resumeHint: Continue the run to finish them; steps that finished are taken over.

mcp.downgrade: The service states that this tool is “{{stated}}”. You classify it as “{{chosen}}”, which is less strict: for example, it could then be approved in advance and would be asked about like a less dangerous tool.
mcp.downgradeConfirm: I checked the tool: the less strict classification is right
mcp.https_required: Services are reached over https only. http is possible only for a development server on this computer (127.0.0.1 or localhost).
mcp.loopback_toggle: http is possible only for a development server on this computer: switch on “{{toggle}}” below.

import.not_object: This file is not a Nodestro workflow: it contains no workflow object. Export a workflow in the editor (Export) and import that file.
import.no_nodes: This file is not a Nodestro workflow: it has no steps ("nodes"). Export a workflow in the editor (Export) and import that file.
import.node_invalid: This file is not a valid Nodestro workflow: step {{index}} has no id or type.
import.edges_invalid: This file is not a valid Nodestro workflow: its connections ("edges") are not a list.
import.edge_invalid: This file is not a valid Nodestro workflow: connection {{index}} has no start or end.

conflict.title: Changed somewhere else
conflict.text: This workflow was saved somewhere else at {{time}} (in another tab or by someone else) after you opened it. Saving now would replace that change.
conflict.reloadHint: Load the saved version: your unsaved changes here are dropped.
conflict.copyHint: Keep mine as a copy: your state becomes a new workflow, the saved one stays as it is.
conflict.overwriteHint: Save mine anyway: your state replaces the other change.
conflict.versions: Nothing is lost for good either way: every save is kept under Versions, where you can compare and restore it.

compat.effortText: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (for example Ollama or vLLM) do not accept an effort setting from Nodestro. Set this agent's effort to “Model default”.

rules.off: Approvals per tool call are not switched on in this installation: tools run without asking first.
rules.legacyNotRunOn: The activation step has not run yet: assignments from before are asked about like new ones.
rules.stampHintOn: Marks the assignments that exist now in workflows, versions and published releases as exceptions, so they keep working without a question. Review the list afterwards; it runs only once.

request.title: The request does not fit the API's input:

kind.extra: is not part of the input
kind.choice: is not one of the allowed values
